scope: Own-clock native reference helper diagnostic; root self-review; no GPU execution or strict upper bound.

terminal.scope: Official Kimina HTTP/SDK replay; recorded SDK/REPL/native closure; CPU-only, root self-review.

memory_watchdog.scope: Whole owned experiment tree RSS sum; sampled response, not a kernel RSS quota. Includes retained descendants after reparenting.

terminal.cpu_scope: Not validated exhaustive descendant CPU; no pure solver attribution.

resource_accounting.scope: Conservative sum of owned process RSS, sampled non-atomically. Not kernel-hard RSS enforcement or PSS; overshoot remains visible.

observed_native_EOF_exits.scope: Observed no-response EOF diagnostics only, not exhaustive normal/cancelled descendant exit accounting.

HTTP.scope: First recorded HTTP request to final recorded response for each source, including inter-attempt retry gaps. Excludes SDK waiting before the first request and final process retirement; whole clocks include them. Missing network response ends stay censored. Concurrent source spans overlap, not CPU/removable wall or Amdahl.

limitations: Nested stage sums overlap; exact repair exclusive subtracts nested verification only.
Whole/request wall includes preparation, packing, communication, logging, cancellation and cleanup; no historical rescaling.
Request guard starts after initial context JSON parse and ends before stdout flush; residual is not all IPC.
Non-helper/stock calls, omega and hard-death missing events are not silently pure LP or zero.
Exact fallback includes matrix construction, coefficient conversion and rational cleanup, not only pivot loops.
Shapes include the actual FP normalization row and accumulated matrix nonzeros, not maxVar/tableau dimensions or wire terms.
Exact fallback shape and per-call nonlinear product provenance remain unavailable.
Matrix-ready until native-answer overlap is only a hypothetical race window; it includes repair and is not a GPU queue/batch.
